info.text:
# AP Tombola

## What Does Randomization do to this Game?
- For each number, an item is generated and sent to the multiworld
- When a number is received, you can mark it in the Card
- Marking enough numbers to complete a "Score" sends out one or more checks

The Scores possible are:
- 2 in any one row of the card (Ambo)
- 3 in any one row of the card (Terno)
- 4 in any one row of the card (Quaterna)
- 1 entire row of the card (Cinquina)
- 2 entire rows of the card (Decina)
- All of the numbers in the card (Tombola)

## What is the Goal of AP Tombola in Archipelago

The goal of AP Tombola is to get a certain amount of Tombola Scored, configurable in the YAML

## What is Required to Play the Game in Archipelago?

The Client, currently available as a Windows Executable, Linux Executable and as a web page on https://arenes214.itch.io/ap-tombola

## Set Up Guide

- Generate a game with AP Tombola and other games in it
- Launch the client and connect to the server
- All of the cards will be shown, and you can start marking numbers received

### Installing the APWorld

- Download and install the latest archipelago release from the archipelago releases page.
- Download aptombola.apworld
- Navigate to your archipelago installation (default on Windows C:\ProgramData\Archipelago).
- Navigate to custom_worlds under your archipelago base folder.
- Move aptombola.apworld into this folder.

### Generating a game

- Generate the AP Tombola YAML file
- Edit the file to have your desired settings.
- Navigate to your archipelago installation (default C:\ProgramData\Archipelago).
- Navigate to \players under your archipelago base folder.
- Move the YAML into this folder, as well as YAMLs for other games, as needed.
- Navigate back to your archipelago base folder and run ArchipelagoGenerate.exe
- Your generated game will be in the \output folder under the archipelago base folder.

### Joining a multiworld:

- Navigate to https://arenes214.itch.io/ap-tombola or download the Windows/Linux client from the releases tab
- Launch the game
- Connect to the room via the room URL.

readme.text:
APWorld for AP Tombola, a classic italian bingo game implemented as a meta game for the Archipelago Multiworld Randomizer.

For information on how to play the game read the [Documentation](https://github.com/Arenes214/APWorld-Tombola/blob/master/docs/en_AP%20Tombola.md)

notes.text:
## New Additions - APWorld
- **Easy Item Links**
Link your items with other Tombola players in the world by simply writing what categories of item you want to link!
Unlike normal item links, this option accounts for players having different amounts of a particular item, and is able to link *the highest* amount of items theoretically linkable.
Example Usage: `easy_item_links: ["Numbers","Traps & Shields","Unlocks","Free Location Hints","Free Marks"]`
- **Deprioritize Numbers** Yaml Option
Sets the "Deprioritized" flag on numbers, so that they do not appear in other players' Priority Locations
- **Universal Tracker Support**
- New Milestones Added
- New Filler Items Added
- Moved to Rule Builder

## New Additions - Client
- Added the ability to modify the info for slots you have saved
- When sending a hinted item, there is now a client-side notification in chat
- The Title of the game's window now contains Slot Name and Save Name when connected to a slot
- Updated GodotAP to commit `177e052` to fix a security issue

## Changes - APWorld
- Rowsanity is now enabled by default
- Tombola Milestones that require more Tombola than what's required for goal cannot be rolled

## Changes - Client
- Automark now happens 3 seconds after receiving a Number (Timer is shown on top-right, where the Shields Counter/Trap Timer resides)
- Automark now also marks Milestones
- When trying to use a Free Mark, a "Please Wait" message now shows before the server sends the go-ahead to Free Mark a number

# Bugfixes
- Fixed Automark not marking numbers in some situations
- Enabling Automark now tries to mark numbers and milestones
- Fixed enabling Automark in-game not persisting in case of a Disconnect
- Fixed Automark not opening Cards
- Fixed Free Location Hints being able to choose a location that is already hinted
- Fixed Slot Names for Item Links you are a part of not being highlighted in chat
- Fixed the counter of Shields you currently have not visually updating if no shields were already used
- Fixed Hint messages having an extra space
- Controller Inputs are now ignored
- Fixed being able to send an empty message in chat
- Fixed Free Marked Numbers visually not being marked after a Blindness Trap
- Client now uses **drastically less** CPU/GPU resources
